newsitem.title: UK: BA to hear cabin crew strike vote result.
newsitem.headline: BA to hear cabin crew strike vote result.

text.p: British Airways will know on Wednesday if cabin crew have voted for strike action in a long-running pay dispute, the Transport and General Workers Union (T&G) said on Tuesday.
"The result of the ballot of British Airways cabin crew will be announced tomorrow," the T&G said in a statement, adding this would be at 1000 GMT.
The British Airline Stewards and Stewardesses Association, a branch of the T&G, ballotted 10,000 members over possible strike action.
The vote came after five months of talks between BA and the union broke down over the failure to agree on BA's proposals for pay restructuring.
The proposed deal would provide crew with higher pensionable pay, in return for efficiencies within the department and lower pay rates for new crew staff.
